boot: Ugh. Who scheduled an invasion during my 14th nap?
I'm not fat, I'm portable lasagna security.
Fine. I'll defend the lasagna. But this counts as cardio.
Loading tactical belly... done. It was already loaded.
Rodents again? I hope they brought snacks. For me.
Alert: vermin detected. Belly: ready. Enthusiasm: pending.
gameStart: Paws on deck. The lasagna shall not fall!
They came for the lasagna. They leave as furballs.
Time to furball some freeloaders off my carpet.
My diet plan for today: mice. Low carb. High protein.
Engaging enemy. Slowly. I just ate.
Operation Tummy Shield is a go.
waveClear: Wave down. Napping resumes in... oh. More of them.
Is it dinner yet? I cleared a whole wave.
Forty rodents. Zero lasagna lost. I demand tuna.
That's how a professional does it. Now scratch my ears.
Cleared. Can someone refill my bowl while I work?
Wave schmaved. Bring on the next batch.
roombaHit: BOOM. Roomba rodeo! That general owes me a tuna.
Two hundred points AND a clean floor? I'm efficient.
That rat general just got evicted. By me. The landlord.
Direct hit! I'd celebrate, but I'm mid-snack.
Scratch that ride, general. This is my house.
Ka-ching. I'll spend it all on snacks.
lifeLost: Ouch! That crumb had opinions. Rude.
I meant to do that. Tactical belly absorption.
Hey! Only I get to throw food around here!
Losing a life. Worth it: I dodge nothing before lunch.
Note to self: crumbs are not edible when they fly at you.
dodge: You can't hit the blob. The blob is wise.
Sidestep! I learned that from the Roomba.
Too slow, crumb. I may be round, but I'm quick.
Missed me! Now hold still, I'm tired.
Weaving. Weaving. Perfectly balanced. As all cats should be.
idle: Any lasagna thieves left? I have spare furballs.
This counts as exercise. Tell my vet.
Standing guard. Sitting guard. Lying-down guard.
I could really use a snack break. After this wave.
gameOver: The lasagna... it fell. I need a moment. And a snack.
Ugh. Add that to the list of things I did for food.
Game over?! I was just warming up my belly!
Fine, rodents. You win this round of chess.
Even heroes need nap breaks. Long ones.
sessionEnd: Session over. Payment in tuna, as usual.
That's all, folks. The fat cat is officially off duty.
I did my part. Where's my treat?
Retreating to my blanket. Legacy intact. Belly fuller.
Logging off. Do NOT touch the lasagna while I'm gone.
